mainEntity.name: Do you provide home service across Delhi, Noida & NCR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, GR Solution provides doorstep repair services across Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad and nearby NCR areas.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can a technician visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most nearby service areas, we try to arrange same-day or next-day technician visits depending on availability and the repair issue.

mainEntity.name: Which TV types do you repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: We repair LED, LCD, OLED/QLED, Plasma, Curved and large-screen televisions from major brands.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair TV panels and display issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we handle panel-related issues, display lines, backlight problems, no display, screen flickering and panel bonding cases where repair is possible.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide warranty after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty depends on the repair type and parts used. Our team explains the warranty terms clearly before starting the repair.

mainEntity.name: Can I get an estimate before repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, after diagnosis we share the repair estimate clearly so you can approve the work before any paid repair begins.
We use genuine or high-quality compatible parts depending on availability, device model and customer approval.

mainEntity.name: How can I book a repair service?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can call directly, send a WhatsApp message, or submit the enquiry form on the website. Our team will contact you for details and scheduling.
